metadata.name: hookwars_book
metadata.description: Hookwars (units): a fully escrowed spot order book for materials and standing bids for item classes (docs/spec/11-hook-economy.md section 6).

instructions.name: apply_market_terms
docs: Anyone applies a market's pending terms once ready (checked against the bounds again).
Resting orders keep their prices; new orders use the new tick.

instructions.name: apply_params
docs: Anyone applies a pending change once it is ready.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: The owner cancels a resting order and gets its escrow back.

accounts.name: config
docs: Pass 5 (I-6): read for `min_rest_secs`.

instructions.name: cancel_class_bid
docs: The bidder closes a class bid; every lamport goes back.

instructions.name: crank
docs: Anyone removes up to `max` expired orders (bids first, then asks, in book order), returning
their escrow to the owners and taking their bounties. Remaining accounts: a `(wallet, base
holding)` pair per order removed.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Opens the book of a craft material (one per material). Requires `Trader >=
BOOK_CREATE_LEVEL` (3.3).

instructions.name: init
docs: Creates the config; the program's upgrade authority signs.

instructions.name: match_class
docs: The holder of a fitting item sells it into a class bid: the item moves to the bidder, the
price less the taker fee to the seller, both fees to the treasury, the bid account closes
to the bidder. Refused for an item that is listed, leased or equipped.

instructions.name: place
docs: Places a limit order: crosses the best opposite orders (price, then time; expired orders
are skipped), up to `BOOK_MATCH_MAX` fills, then rests what is left if it is at least
`min_size`. Remaining accounts: a `(wallet, base holding)` pair for each maker filled, in
book order, then one for the evicted owner when the side is full.

instructions.name: place_class_bid
docs: Opens a standing bid for any item of `class` at `price`; the bid account holds the price
and the maker fee.

instructions.name: propose_market_terms
docs: The admin proposes a market's tick and minimum size (inside the config's bounds); they apply
after `admin_timelock_secs` (review 3 M-8).

instructions.name: propose_params
docs: The admin proposes new params and treasury; they apply after `admin_timelock_secs`.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: the signer is not this program's upgrade authority

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: only the book admin may do this

errors.name: BadParams
errors.msg: a book parameter is out of bounds

errors.name: NotReady
errors.msg: no change is pending, or it is not ready yet

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one expected

errors.name: BadBase
errors.msg: the base is not a material of the craft program

errors.name: BadPrice
errors.msg: the price is zero or not a multiple of the tick

errors.name: BadSize
errors.msg: the size is zero or below the minimum

errors.name: WouldCross
errors.msg: a post-only order would cross

errors.name: BookFull
errors.msg: the book side is full and the order is not better than its worst

errors.name: NoSuchOrder
errors.msg: no such order

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: only the order's owner may do this

errors.name: LevelTooLow
errors.msg: the creator's Trader level is too low

errors.name: ClassMismatch
errors.msg: the item does not fit the class, or is listed, leased or equipped

errors.name: BidExpired
errors.msg: the class bid has expired

errors.name: NotAnItem
errors.msg: not an item of the armory

errors.name: NotItemHolder
errors.msg: the signer does not hold the item

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: BadTerms
errors.msg: the tick or minimum size is outside the config's bounds

errors.name: RestTooShort
errors.msg: the order has not rested the minimum time, or would expire before it

types.name: BookConfig
docs: `BookConfig` at `["book-config"]`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives every book fee (11 section 2.4).

fields.name: protocol_fees_total
docs: Every lamport of fees the protocol has received.

types.name: BookEscrow
docs: `BookEscrow` at `["book-escrow", market]`: holds the bids' lamports (above its rent) and owns
the holding of the asks' base.

types.name: BookMarket
docs: `BookMarket` at `["book", base_mint]`: a material book (11 section 6.2). Quote is native SOL
(lamports), held by `["book-escrow", market]` with the base of the asks.

fields.name: min_size
docs: `min_size`: the least base units an order may rest with.

fields.name: bids
docs: Best first: highest price, then oldest.

fields.name: asks
docs: Best first: lowest price, then oldest.

types.name: BookParams
docs: The book's parameters (11 section 11; every one "to set").

fields.name: taker_bps
docs: `BOOK_TAKER_BPS`: paid by the taker on every fill.

fields.name: maker_bps
docs: `BOOK_MAKER_BPS`: paid by the maker on every fill (may be 0).

fields.name: slots
docs: `BOOK_SLOTS`: resting orders per side (at most `SLOTS_CAP`).

fields.name: match_max
docs: `BOOK_MATCH_MAX`: fills per `place`.

fields.name: create_level
docs: `BOOK_CREATE_LEVEL`: the `Trader` level `create_market` requires (0 = none).

fields.name: order_bounty_lamports
docs: Deposit each order leaves in escrow; back to the owner on fill, cancel or eviction, to the
cranker when the order expires (the crank bounty, rule 5).

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS` (00).

fields.name: tick_min_lamports
docs: Least and most tick a market may have (review 3 M-8; owner values, 00 section 6).

fields.name: min_size_max
docs: Most `min_size` a market may have (review 3 M-8).

fields.name: skill_min_fee_lamports
docs: A fill counts toward the Trader skill only when its fees reach this (review 3 L-1).

fields.name: min_rest_secs
docs: Pass 5 (review 3 I-6): `BOOK_MIN_REST_SECS`, the least time an order rests before its
owner may cancel it, and the least time to its expiry (owner value, 00 section 6).

types.name: ClassBid
docs: `ClassBid` at `["class-bid", bidder, nonce]`: a standing bid for any item of a class (R44). The
account itself holds the price and the maker fee above its rent.

types.name: ClassKey
docs: What a class bid asks for (11 section 6.3 `ClassKey`).

fields.name: side
docs: Side of the taker.

types.name: Order
docs: A resting order. Prices are lamports per base unit.

fields.name: size
docs: Base units left.

fields.name: quote_locked
docs: Bids: lamports still escrowed for this order (quote plus the maker fee reserve).

fields.name: expires_at
docs: 0 = never.

fields.name: placed_at
docs: Pass 5 (I-6): when the order was placed.

types.name: PendingBook
docs: `PendingBook` at `["book-pending"]`.

types.name: PendingMarketTerms
docs: `PendingMarketTerms` at `["book-pending-terms", market]`: an admin change of one market's tick
and minimum size, applied after `admin_timelock_secs` (review 3 M-8).

fields.name: size
docs: Size asked for, and size left resting after the matches.

types.name: ProtocolFee
docs: Every protocol collection (11 section 2.4); `mint` is the default key for native lamports.

types.name: Unpayable
docs: Review 3 M-1: lamports owed to a wallet that cannot hold them (it does not exist and the sum is
below the rent minimum) went to the instruction's payer instead.
